Nina (eng-arch): proposal: emit signed, compact policy blobs from compiler; runtime hot-swaps verified blobs and runs a tiny deterministic decision step.
Sam (eng-runtime): fine by me. runtime must never crash on bad blob -> fallback to safe_default.
Jules (eng-platform): store blobs in S3, signed with KMS. control plane exposes watch API. canary by percentage.
Nina (eng-arch): compiler responsibilities: validate DAG of fallbacks, sim coverage, attach tests_run_id + semantic hash.
Sam (eng-runtime): keep blob format binary (flatbuffers/protobuf). parsing budget <1ms. per-tenant deltas allowed but bounded to score-deltas only.
Jules (eng-platform): revocation list + short TTL for ephemeral overrides. audit log on activation.
ops-bot: noted  will create canary checklist and alert thresholds when RFC posted.
Nina (eng-arch): action items: Nina -> draft RFC with schema; Sam -> proto + perf bench; Jules -> watch/sign plan. RFC by EOD +1.
